instruction: Fix `append_line` so it writes a trailing newline after each line (successive appends currently concatenate onto one line).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops.py b/fileops.py
--- a/fileops.py
+++ b/fileops.py
@@ -58,4 +58,4 @@
 def append_line(path, line):
     """Append ``line`` (plus a newline) to ``path``."""
     with open(path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
-        f.write(line)
+        f.write(line + "\n")
